meta.title: 我今天必须教会你，蒙版！
meta.title_en: Let Me Teach You Masking — Today!
meta.topic: 摄影修图 · 蒙版原理

scenes.context: 蒙版在修图和剪辑中都特别重要，但很多人不知道它是什么。
sentences: 这个蒙版到底是啥呀？
What on earth is this mask thing?
on earth（到底）表强调
在修图和剪辑中都特别重要。
It's really important in both photo editing and video editing.
photo editing（修图）
难不难？
Is it hard?
注意 Is it 的升调疑问句
不难，我教你。
It's not hard. I'll teach you.
teach sb.（教某人）
paraphrase: 换个问法问「这是啥」
What on earth is a mask?
把「重要」说得更口语
It's a big deal in photo and video editing.
scenes.speak: What on earth is this mask thing? It's really important in both photo editing and video editing. Is it hard? It's not hard. I'll teach you.

scenes.context: 想显示哪儿就涂白，想隐藏哪儿就涂黑——这就是蒙版的全部秘密。
sentences: 不小心擦多了，怎么办？
What if I erased too much by accident?
by accident（不小心）
蒙版就相当于给照片上叠加一块板子。
A mask is like layering a board on top of the photo.
layer（叠加，动词）
想显示哪儿，就涂上白色。
Paint white where you want to show.
where 引导地点状语从句
白加黑减。
White adds, black subtracts.
subtract（减去）
paraphrase: 把「不小心」换个说法
What if I erased too much by mistake?
「白加黑减」的另一种英文表达
Paint white to reveal, black to conceal.
scenes.speak: What if I erased too much by accident? A mask is like layering a board on top of the photo. Paint white where you want to show. White adds, black subtracts.

scenes.context: 蒙版最大的好处：所有修改都在蒙板上，原图完好无损。
sentences: 在蒙板上操作，不破坏照片本身。
You work on the mask, without touching the photo itself.
work on（在…上操作）
可以随意修改。
You can edit it however you like.
however you like（随意）
那像换天，都是这么做的。
Sky replacement works the same way.
sky replacement（换天）
paraphrase: 把「不破坏」说具体
The original photo stays untouched.
「随意修改」另一种说法
You can tweak it as much as you want.
scenes.speak: You work on the mask, without touching the photo itself. You can edit it however you like. Sky replacement works the same way.

scenes.context: 人脸太暗时，在亮度涂层上加蒙版，只让亮度作用在脸上。
sentences: 背景正常，但是人脸太暗。
The background is fine, but the face is too dark.
background（背景）
直接调亮度，整个画面都变亮了。
Brightening it directly lights up the whole frame.
brighten（变亮）
只把脸部涂白。
Paint only the face white.
only 放在动词前强调
这个亮度调整就只在脸部才有了。
Now the brightness adjustment only applies to the face.
apply to（作用于）
paraphrase: 「画面」的另一种说法
Brightening it directly brightens the entire picture.
把「作用于」换个说法
The adjustment now affects only the face.
scenes.speak: The background is fine, but the face is too dark. Brightening it directly lights up the whole frame. Paint only the face white. Now the brightness adjustment only applies to the face.

scenes.context: A段视频随电线杆边界逐渐隐藏，下一层视频露出——线性蒙版让过渡轻松实现。
sentences: 其实它只有两段视频。
It's actually just two video clips.
video clips（视频片段）
随着电线杆的边界逐渐隐藏了。
It gradually hides along the edge of the utility pole.
gradually（逐渐地）
这是一个线性蒙版。
This is a linear mask.
linear（线性的）
直线的一边显示，另一边隐藏。
One side of the line shows, the other hides.
one side / the other side（一边…另一边…）
贴合电线杆向左移动，就轻松实现了。
Slide it left along the pole, and it's done.
slide（滑动）
paraphrase: 把「逐渐隐藏」换个说法
It fades out little by little along the pole.
「轻松实现」另一种表达
Move it along the pole to the left, and it works like a charm.
scenes.speak: It's actually just two video clips. It gradually hides along the edge of the utility pole. This is a linear mask. One side of the line shows, the other hides. Slide it left along the pole, and it's done.

practice: What on earth is this mask thing?
想显示哪儿，就涂上白色。
Paint white where you want to show.
这个亮度调整就只在脸部有了。
The brightness adjustment only applies to the face.
贴合电线杆向左移动，就轻松实现了。
Slide it left along the pole, and it's done.
pitfalls: The mask is very important in photos and videos.
The mask is really important in both photo editing and video editing.
photo editing 才是「修图」，photo 本身只是照片
Paint white where do you want to show.
Paint white where you want to show.
where 引导从句时用陈述语序，不用疑问倒装
I want to adjust only at face.
I want the adjustment to apply only to the face.
apply to 才表示「作用于」，介词不能漏
Slide the mask to the left.
固定说法 to the left / to the right 需加 the
shifts: 蒙版上涂黑白色，随时可改
以为蒙版只是照片工具
修图、调色、视频过渡全靠它
在蒙版上涂白，只作用局部
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：视频原文「蒙板」为语音转写误差，正文统一为「蒙版」。
